Actual market usage
By-category active users, leads accepted and policies bound
Advertising alone does not identify the categories generating revenue
Geographic operating footprint
Named licensed intermediary, active insurer and placement limits per category/country
Brazil development roots do not prove Brazilian insurance placement
Commercial terms
Net accepted-lead fee, refund/clawback terms, exclusivity, renewal remuneration
Premium volume does not establish Objais revenue
Acquisition economics
CAC by channel/category and accepted-lead yield
Needed before judging tickets as too low or ranking segments by profit
Retention
Meaningful user actions and contractual revenue by 30/60/90 days and annual cohort
Low buying frequency cannot substitute for retention measurement
Regional market totals
Brazil/Portugal specialist watch, bag, art, yacht and pet-insurance totals
Public proxies do not form a comparable national TAM
Current availability
Resolve health/home labels and FAQ-only wine/instrument categories
Exclude uncertain and planned scope from present market
Operational rights
Insurer-accepted records, policy update and claims permissions, data rights
App features cannot be assumed to amend cover or receive revenue
